error: kip848/member_loss missing ids; share/secure_reconnect ready_timeout_a or empty fetch; classic/kip848 max_poll missing survivor ids
cause: KIP-848 exclusive assignment left the second member with no partitions. Waiting on GO without polling exceeded max.poll.interval. The SASL one-node fixture used the default RF=3 share coordinator topic.
fix: Start the surviving member first. Only the leaving/holding member may READY without an assignment. Poll while waiting for GO. SASL node uses RF=1 share coordinator state and upgrades share.version. Share recovery cells rejoin before produce.
